sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a shrimp character. Draw this exact shrimp character as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the head shell: the orange-pink head and front body shell with its pointed nose, facing left as in image 1, without feelers, without legs and without its tail segments, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no mouth — keep the rosy cheek; its back end rounded.
2. the front of the tail: the first three curved tail segments, as in image 1, drawn whole, both ends rounded.
3. the end of the tail: the last two tail segments, as in image 1, drawn whole, both ends rounded.
4. the tail fan: the orange fan tail at the end, as in image 1, with a rounded base.
5. one feeler: one long thin curving feeler, drawn whole, with a rounded base.
6. the legs: the row of little thin curved legs from under its body in image 1, drawn as one piece joined at the top, with a rounded top.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a shrimp character; image 2 shows the same shrimp cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the shrimp's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the shrimp in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the shrimp's eye as it is in image 1: a dark round eye with a white sparkle and a white rim.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: the pupil looking down, its upper lid drooping and tilted, a thin shine of a welling tear along the bottom rim.
6. the same eye crying: gently squeezed shut, a soft downward-curving line (a sad closed eye, not a smile), a few small lashes, and one small light-blue teardrop just below it.
7. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small happy smile.
8. the mouth laughing: open wide, a little pink inside.
9. the mouth a small round "o".
10. the mouth sad: a small downturned frown.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.
